articles.headline: China’s CXMT swings to profit as memory prices rise on computing demand
articles.summary: CXMT’s first earnings release since listing showed a sharp turnaround to profit in the first half, helped by higher prices and sales of memory products. For businesses, this points to continued strength in memory demand tied to AI and computing infrastructure, which can influence hardware costs and supply planning.

articles.headline: Solstice and Element terminate $14.5 billion merger after shareholder feedback
articles.summary: The deal collapse signals how shareholder pressure can derail large technology transactions even after months of negotiation. For executives, it is a reminder that strategic acquisitions in tech can face major financing, governance, and valuation risk.

articles.headline: McKinsey says enterprise AI is paying off, but costs remain a hurdle
articles.summary: McKinsey’s latest findings highlight that AI is finally producing enterprise gains, but the gap between individual productivity wins and organization-wide impact remains wide. For businesses, rising AI costs and limited efficiency improvements mean leaders still need careful ROI tracking before scaling deployments.
